Asked if he can send the Guard into Chicago without the governor's OK, Trump: "I mean, you can violate the governor. You can go in."
The Supreme Court refused to let him in December 2025. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-chicago-national-guard-violate-the-governor/

Trump on Chicago, Saturday: "we could have that place fixed up in two weeks... I could set that up."
He tried in 2025. A judge blocked it, the Supreme Court refused to lift the block, and the troops had already gone home. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-chicago-national-guard-violate-the-governor/

trump-iran-attack-wall-street-journal-qu.text:
A WSJ reporter asks how far along a possible Iran attack is. Trump: "can anybody from the Wall Street Journal ask a question so stupid?"
Then: "we're thinking about doing it and maybe tomorrow." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-iran-attack-wall-street-journal-question-so-stupid/

Less than a minute after calling a WSJ question "so stupid", Trump cites the WSJ: "your paper wrote... that we're getting more oil out of the Hormuz Strait" than before the war. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-iran-attack-wall-street-journal-question-so-stupid/

Trump says the WSJ reported more oil through Hormuz than before the war.
The Journal said total Gulf flows beat prewar levels. Through Hormuz itself, about 82%. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-iran-attack-wall-street-journal-question-so-stupid/

trump-press-room-swimming-pool-stupid-th.text:
Trump, Saturday: the White House pool "will never be brought back. I NEVER even thought to do such a stupid thing!"
His former press secretary Karoline Leavitt told Bill Maher on Friday he was "flirting" with it. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-press-room-swimming-pool-stupid-thing/

Trump denies a plan to swap the White House press room for a pool, then adds: "I may move the Fake News to a less obnoxious location." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-press-room-swimming-pool-stupid-thing/

trump-pardons-junior-staff-margo-not-goi.text:
Asked about pardoning junior staff, Trump: "Well, I haven't thought of it."
Less than a minute later: "Margo, you're not going to have to worry about it, okay?" https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pardons-junior-staff-margo-not-going-to-have-to-worry/

Trump on pardons for his staff: "certainly I haven't thought about it, but certainly I'd be allowed to."
White House attorneys are weighing it, per The Washington Sun. He hasn't thought about it, per him. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pardons-junior-staff-margo-not-going-to-have-to-worry/

"The presidential pardons are, they say, the most powerful thing a president has."
Then Trump told an aide standing nearby she's "not going to have to worry about it." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pardons-junior-staff-margo-not-going-to-have-to-worry/

trump-oil-freaking-fortune-dont-give-a-d.text:
Trump: "my people said, please don't mention that, sir, because people are paying a little higher."
Then: "I don't give a damn. I'm going to say it." The oil money? "A freaking fortune." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-oil-freaking-fortune-dont-give-a-damn/

Trump wrote his own headline in Georgia: "President Trump is talking about all the money they're making while people are suffering at the pump."
Then he said it anyway. Georgia gas is up 90 cents on a year ago, per AAA. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-oil-freaking-fortune-dont-give-a-damn/

Trump told a rally in Georgia the oil money adds up to "a freaking fortune."
Georgia diesel: $5.73 a gallon, up $2.26 on a year ago, per AAA. That's about two-thirds more, by our math. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-oil-freaking-fortune-dont-give-a-damn/

trump-pee-wee-herman-im-not-in-georgia-m.text:
Trump acts out a call from "Pee-wee Herman": "Tell him I'm not in. I'm not in. But he needs money for Georgia. I don't give a damn what he wants."
Earlier that night he said he sees Jon Ossoff as Pee-wee Herman. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pee-wee-herman-im-not-in-georgia-money/

Trump in Georgia: a president "has a lot of power, a big difference when he likes the people representing a state."
And when the guy he calls Pee-wee Herman needs money for Georgia: "I don't give a damn what he wants." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pee-wee-herman-im-not-in-georgia-money/

"And probably I shouldn't say that because they'll say this is not appropriate."
Trump, seconds after "I don't give a damn what he wants" about a call seeking money for Georgia. Then: "When other people call me, I'm terrible." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-pee-wee-herman-im-not-in-georgia-money/

trump-shit-house-countries-denmark-gave-.text:
Trump: "why do we always have to take people from shithouse countries? Why can't we take people from, like, well, Norway, Sweden? Why not Denmark?"
Then: "They gave us Greenland." They did not. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-shit-house-countries-denmark-gave-us-greenland/

"Denmark gave us. We signed an agreement," Trump said of Greenland.
Denmark's PM says the agreement "acknowledges and respects the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Denmark." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-shit-house-countries-denmark-gave-us-greenland/

Trump in Georgia on Somalis in the US: "They all have a Mercedes Benz."
Then: "low IQ, and they live better than you do... Maybe they're not as low as we think." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-shit-house-countries-denmark-gave-us-greenland/

trump-stone-outside-of-italy-reflecting-.text:
Trump on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool: "it's the longest swimming pool in history."
Prosecutors dropped the vandalism cases and later called it a botched installation, per WTOP. He's still blaming vandals. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-stone-outside-of-italy-reflecting-pool/

"I know more about stone than any human being outside of Italy. Only the Italians know a little bit more."
The Lincoln statue is Georgia marble, per the Park Service, carved by the Piccirilli brothers, Italian immigrants in the Bronx. He said this in Georgia. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-stone-outside-of-italy-reflecting-pool/

Trump in Perry, Georgia, on the Reflecting Pool: "It was built in 1922, and it hasn't worked ever. It leaked."
Then: "we had tremendous vandalism." The company that did the work says it's the primer, not vandals, per WTOP. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-stone-outside-of-italy-reflecting-pool/

trump-murkowski-worst-senator-second-or-.text:
Trump on Lisa Murkowski: "Everyone thought she came in second or third, but then she 'won.' Miracles happen!"
Alaska's official 2022 count: Murkowski 43.39%, Tshibaka 42.62%. In round one. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-murkowski-worst-senator-second-or-third/

Trump calls Murkowski "a DISGRACE to Alaska and our Country" for opposing the DOJ's Alaska lawsuit.
What she said: "Alaskans don't need any help voting for their preferred candidates." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-murkowski-worst-senator-second-or-third/

Trump says ranked choice voting is a "SCAM" Murkowski "came up with."
Voters adopted it by ballot initiative in 2020. The miracle: the person with the most votes won. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-murkowski-worst-senator-second-or-third/

trump-obama-michigan-place-was-empty.text:
Trump: "I saw Barack Hussein Obama was in Michigan and the place was empty."
Bridge Michigan: a crowd of "more than 4,300 Michigan voters." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-obama-michigan-place-was-empty/

Trump on Obama's Detroit rally: "the place was empty." Seconds later: "They don't talk about my crowds, they never talk about them."
Bridge Michigan put the crowd at more than 4,300. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-obama-michigan-place-was-empty/

Trump, 12:42am: Abdul El-Sayed is "a Fake Doctor."
Bridge Michigan's fact check: El-Sayed holds a doctor of medicine degree from Columbia. He isn't a licensed physician and doesn't treat patients. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-obama-michigan-place-was-empty/

trump-iran-who-the-hell-are-we-negotiati.text:
Trump on Iran's leadership: level one, gone, level two, gone.
Then: "I got to stop because I got to figure out who the hell are we negotiating with?" https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-iran-who-the-hell-are-we-negotiating-with/

Friday, Trump on Iran: if they're smart, "they'll just say, let's get down to business."
Saturday: "I got to figure out who the hell are we negotiating with?" https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-iran-who-the-hell-are-we-negotiating-with/

trump-data-centers-pay-everybody-20000.text: Trump on data centers: "Tell them to pay you $10,000, $15,000, $20,000 for everybody that lives in the community. They'll do it. You just got to ask." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-data-centers-pay-everybody-20000/

Trump says Meta "agreed to pay everybody $10,000" in Louisiana.
What we found: Richland Parish teachers' bonuses, paid out of a 1968 parish sales tax on Meta's construction spending. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-data-centers-pay-everybody-20000/

trump-loudermilk-russian-spies-capitol-t.text:
Trump says Barry Loudermilk's constituents were accused of being "Russian spies."
The 2022 accusation was a "reconnaissance" tour the day before January 6. Capitol Police said "there is no evidence." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-loudermilk-russian-spies-capitol-tour/

Trump: "they're two little kids. And they said, they're Russian spies."
Capitol Police in 2022: "a group of approximately 12 people which later grew to 15 people," in the House office buildings, not the Capitol. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-loudermilk-russian-spies-capitol-tour/

trump-gas-double-and-triple-small-price-.text: Trump on the Iran war and your gas: "I thought gas would be double and triple. And it's a small price to pay." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-double-and-triple-small-price-to-pay/

Trump: "...you're taking a hit. It's not a big hit. I thought gasoline would go up much more."
AAA, Sunday: regular $4.29, up from $3.06 a year ago. Diesel $6.35, up from $3.66. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-double-and-triple-small-price-to-pay/

Last week, your gas bill was "a small price to pay." This week he says he expected it to go "double and triple," and has "no second guess." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-gas-double-and-triple-small-price-to-pay/

trump-you-will-only-have-yourselves-to-b.text: Trump on what happens if Democrats win: it all gets "put right back in as soon as they win," and "you will only have yourselves to blame." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-you-will-only-have-yourselves-to-blame/

A minute earlier, on his policies that kick in later: "That's why we have to win because I don't want them to get credit for it." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-you-will-only-have-yourselves-to-blame/

Sunday's suspects, in order: Fox News ("doing little to help"), then you ("you will only have yourselves to blame"). https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-you-will-only-have-yourselves-to-blame/

trump-audi-40-billion-plant.text:
Saturday in Georgia, Trump: Audi "has just committed to invest $4.2 billion."
Sunday in Michigan: "a $40 billion plant."
Audi's release: "around $4 billion." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-audi-40-billion-plant/

Trump, twice this weekend: Audi starts construction "next month."
Audi: construction "is scheduled to begin in 2027." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-audi-40-billion-plant/

In fairness: in Perry he did say "we're totaling about 40 billion," without saying what was being totaled. By Sunday, the total was the plant. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-audi-40-billion-plant/

trump-bill-maher-complete-and-total-lose.text:
Friday, Bill Maher on Trump: "He never interrupts. He never gets mad."
Sunday, Trump on Bill Maher: "this COMPLETE AND TOTAL LOSER." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-bill-maher-complete-and-total-loser/

Trump's review of his Bill Maher dinner, in consecutive sentences: "Overall, I thought it was a good meeting... I learned nothing, and felt it was a waste of time." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-bill-maher-complete-and-total-loser/

Trump on Maher's dinner math: "It didn't last four hours, it lasted two hours, maybe less... We have the timestamps." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-bill-maher-complete-and-total-loser/

trump-jocelyn-benson-thief-detroit-votes.text:
Trump on Jocelyn Benson: "She cheated more, in my opinion, than anybody else... in the entire United States."
Then: "watch all of those Detroit votes." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-jocelyn-benson-thief-detroit-votes/

Trump says Benson "was one of the worst for cheating" in 2020.
Michigan Senate Republicans investigated 2020 and found no evidence of widespread or systematic fraud. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-jocelyn-benson-thief-detroit-votes/
Nine days out, Trump on Detroit votes: he thinks you'll "get a lot of them," but he wants to "make sure they count." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-jocelyn-benson-thief-detroit-votes/

trump-norway-sucks-nobel-shithouse-count.text:
Trump on losing the Nobel Peace Prize: "I said, what about me? Do they do two of them?"
Then: "Frankly, Norway sucks." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-norway-sucks-nobel-shithouse-country/

Midday, on Machado: she gave him the prize, "so how can I say anything else?"
Afternoon: "I didn't get the Nobel Prize... So I don't want anybody from Norway." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-norway-sucks-nobel-shithouse-country/

The "woman that nobody ever heard of," per Trump, is Navi Pillay: a South African jurist and former UN human rights chief. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-norway-sucks-nobel-shithouse-country/

trump-husted-ass-nicki-minaj.text:
Trump, on Jon Husted, again: "I looked at his ass."
Then, to the crowd: "I looked at one hell of a beautiful ass before, Nicki Minaj. That's hard to miss." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-husted-ass-nicki-minaj/

Trump's complaint about the coverage of the Husted bit: the press said "All he wants to do is talk about a man's ass."
His fix was to tell it again. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-husted-ass-nicki-minaj/

trump-el-sayed-metal-detector-senate.text: Trump on Abdul El-Sayed: "He would be the only senator that will have to go through a metal detector before he's allowed to go into the Senate... I want him to have a metal detector." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-el-sayed-metal-detector-senate/

Trump on El-Sayed and Sharia law: "If he ever pulls that one off, he should be the first one that's tried... I'll be a witness." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-el-sayed-metal-detector-senate/

trump-alaska-dan-sullivan-illegal-becaus.text:
Q: How is the other Dan Sullivan illegal?
Trump: "I think it's illegal because it's unfair."
That's the whole theory. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-alaska-dan-sullivan-illegal-because-unfair/

Trump wants Alaska to list "Senator Dan Sullivan as opposed to incumbent because a lot of people don't know what incumbent means."
The ballot already prints "Incumbent" next to the senator's name. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-alaska-dan-sullivan-illegal-because-unfair/

Trump on the other Dan Sullivan: "I think he wasn't even a voter."
Per the Anchorage Daily News, he's been registering to vote in Alaska for 40-plus years. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-alaska-dan-sullivan-illegal-because-unfair/

trump-space-force-mohammed-name-tag-roop.text:
Trump: "Space Force can see everything. I could read, if you had a badge on your jacket, and your first name was Mohammed, I could read that name beautifully right on your jacket."
The reporter: "First name's Roop, R-O-O-P." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-space-force-mohammed-name-tag-roop-raj/

Asked about Iran's underground uranium, Trump picked "Mohammed" as his example name to read off a jacket from space.
Reporter Roop Raj: "First name's Roop."
Trump: "I thought so."
Then: "I was only referring to if you were over there." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-space-force-mohammed-name-tag-roop-raj/

trump-fox-poll-worst-pollsters-cnn-99-pe.text:
Asked about a Fox News poll putting him at 36%, Trump told FOX 2 Detroit: "I don't believe in the Fox poll. I think they have one of the worst pollsters in the world, actually."
He says he looks at CNN's instead. CNN's latest has him at 32%. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-fox-poll-worst-pollsters-cnn-99-percent/

Trump: the CNN poll "just came out that said I'm at 99% within the Republican Party."
CNN's latest poll: 74% among Republicans, a new low.
The Fox poll he doesn't believe: 76%. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-fox-poll-worst-pollsters-cnn-99-percent/

Trump on his overall rating: "If I ran against anybody right now, they say I'd win by 20, 25 points."
Then: "Again, I'm not running." https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-fox-poll-worst-pollsters-cnn-99-percent/

trump-how-the-hell-did-i-ever-win-three-.text:
Trump in Michigan: "How the hell did I ever win three times? You know? How did I do it?"
He won twice. He lost 2020 to Joe Biden, 306 to 232. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-how-the-hell-did-i-ever-win-three-times/

Trump's midterm pitch to Michigan: "pretend that I'm on the ballot."
His reason: when he's not on the ballot, "we get 49% less" of the vote. https://thedonaldfiles.com/trump-videos/trump-how-the-hell-did-i-ever-win-three-times/
